name: AI-PROMPT-sfx-f695271a37bc
annotation:
Low-sanity whisper bed kept under gameplay mix

Low-sanity whisper layer SFX: a crowd of half-audible voices mispronouncing the player character's name, layered with reversed speech fragments and a slow heartbeat underlayer. Must feel like tinnitus rather than a horror jump scare; must remain under the gameplay-critical SFX in mix priority (design rule: horror must not break combat fairness). Deliver 48 kHz WAV, 12-20 s loopable bed, plus a short one-shot trigger variant.
